name: drawing-to-3d
description: Turn an engineering drawing (photo, scan, PDF or DXF; Russian ESKD/GOST or ISO/ASME) into a precise, verified 3D model the way a design engineer works in KOMPAS-3D. Eight deterministic stdlib scripts: a part-spec validator that refuses to proceed while any dimension is an open question; a CadQuery code generator whose script builds STEP + STL and measures what it built; a model verifier (valid solid, overall size, every hole at its drawn position, title-block mass, thread callouts); a native KOMPAS-3D backend that builds the part as an editable feature tree via the KOMPAS API; an ESKD drawing generator (first-angle views, frame, title block form 1, dimensions); an assembly generator with mates, clash check and a GOST 2.106 specification; an exact ASCII DXF geometry extractor; and a self-contained HTML viewer with drawing-standard views. Ships cs-cad-modeler agent and /cs:drawing-to-3d + /cs:cad-verify commands.
